name: ios
//: The Aglyn and Aglyn POS apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac (SwiftUI), built by xcodebuild (README.md).

commands: xcodebuild build -project Aglyn.xcodeproj -scheme Aglyn -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/SourcePackages
xcodebuild build -project Aglyn.xcodeproj -scheme AglynPOS -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/SourcePackages
xcodebuild build -project Aglyn.xcodeproj -scheme Aglyn -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/SourcePackages
xcodebuild build -project Aglyn.xcodeproj -scheme AglynPOS -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/SourcePackages

options.command: xcodebuild test -project Aglyn.xcodeproj -scheme Aglyn -only-testing:AglynTests -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath build/SourcePackages
